findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: AGENTS.md:573 and packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:59 instruct Agents to record through or trigger an authoritative Dynamic Finding applicability/history path as if it were available now. The authoritative plan is explicitly specification-only and future implementation (dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:3-6,59-68,909-967), while the approved proposal requires a compatibility-only disposition before that system exists (sections 7-9) and says historical correction/supersession is used only when available. Omitting that temporal boundary makes all five REVIEW prompts and the Story Owner guidance promise unavailable structured authority, risking fabricated fields/evidence or an impossible workflow; this directly violates CHK-002 adversarial:4 and the no-undelivered-command/field acceptance. severity=critical
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 8baacb207e and 9dd098a003: the canonical REVIEW contract declares Dynamic Finding as future authority, limits current behavior to available CLI compatibility paths, prohibits fabricated fields/signatures/freshness/receipts, and states finding_dismiss is accounting rather than applicability/out_of_scope/repair/resolution proof. Current focused registry semantic smoke and receipts pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-registry-smoke.ts:83 quality-test-gap (medium): the focused triage semantic test only asserts required phrases are present (lines 83-106, 137-139) and has no forbidden/contradictory-permission assertions or mutation cases. findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/prompt-registry.ts:51,58 preserves the Dynamic Finding verdict names but weakens their minimum evidence semantics. Compared with dynamic-finding-system-execution-plan.md:824-835 and the approved proposal section 4, pre_existing_unaffected omits deterministic base/head reproduction plus no-worsening proof; out_of_scope omits signed scope/decision evidence and acceptance non-contradiction; duplicate omits a signature-valid live canonical Finding/owner and no-cycle requirement; stale_or_not_reproduced omits current command receipts with source/runtime freshness and the prohibition on inferring from old DONE. General source-or-command evidence at line 44 does not preserve these verdict-specific thresholds. The gate remains machine-owned, but all five reviewers are taught to propose under-evidenced routing candidates, violating CHK-001/CHK-004 distinct-outcome and current-evidence acceptance. severity=high

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-registry-smoke.ts:121-163 semantic-validation bypass (high): the new validator rejects only four narrowly phrased regex examples, so the required contradictory behaviors still false-green when expressed differently or in uncovered categories. findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/prompt-registry-smoke.ts:121-163 quality-test-gap (medium): F-002 resolution is only partial. The semantic validator has inverse-permission regexes for gap_log/finding_dismiss, dismissal-as-out_of_scope, severity-alone scope, and stale reviewRunId reuse, but none for reviewer repair, story_create permission, unilateral Story expansion, or verdict-specific proof weakening. The added probes specifically reject reviewer repair, story_create, global-green scope expansion, file-disjoint-only pre_existing, weakened verdict evidence, and unsigned, stale, or ownerless duplicate routing. The focused smoke and full verification matrix pass.
